title: When forgiveness keeps feeling costly under pressure
issueStatement: The mind knows the wound but does not know how to loosen its grip. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru links forgiveness to freedom, fearless return, and the end of inner replay. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne. Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment.
actionPrompt: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
